caption: Teaching proposal, AD-04: function-shaped material wear versus uniformly smeared grime on the same mech.

references.role: Exact frozen text direction included verbatim; no input image references.

self_review.result: Suitable for cohesion review. Matched mech, camera, construction and backdrop. Positive differentiated paint, copper, rubber and glass; negative uniform brown-black dirt clearly isolates AD-04. Large labels legible.

Surface finish is detailed and relatively realistic; reviewer should compare with other sections for shared stylization.

caption: Diagrammatic combat HUD mockup, AD-08: clear attack and escape route versus excessive obscuring effects.

references.role: Exact frozen text direction included verbatim; no input image references.

self_review.result: Usable with review flags. Positive chase view shows recognizable rolling mech, raised cutter, amber footprint, open right-side path, health and four labeled slots. Negative obscures attack and escape with effects while retaining matching underlying scene.
issues: Negative panel clips the bottom edges of equipment cards at image boundary, unlike positive; minor framing mismatch beyond intended VFX change.
HUD labels remain substantially legible in negative despite effects; this teaches attack/route obstruction more strongly than HUD obstruction.
Only one hostile cutter appears, not the optional second enemy shape requested. A narrow progress gauge requested in the prompt was omitted. Neither changes the core teaching purpose.
